info.title: Altazion Commerce Theme Packager
info.description: Creates Altazion Commerce .altztheme archives from a source theme folder.

options.name: --source
options.description: Source folder containing theme.general.json, template.json or a signage manifest.json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file for theme or signage, or output directory for a template

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Validate the source without producing archives
pack-signage packages compiled files; the Core-Business importer performs final validation.
